mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile ( user_id, total_play_count, total_play_duration, avg_completion_rate, fav_language, top_singer_id, top_singer_name, active_hour, daily_avg_plays, last_play_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{totalPlayCount}, #{totalPlayDuration}, #{avgCompletionRate}, #{favLanguage}, #{topSingerId}, #{topSingerName}, #{activeHour}, #{dailyAvgPlays}, #{lastPlayAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_play_count = #{totalPlayCount}, total_play_duration = #{totalPlayDuration}, avg_completion_rate = #{avgCompletionRate}, fav_language = #{favLanguage}, top_singer_id = #{topSingerId}, top_singer_name = #{topSingerName}, active_hour = #{activeHour}, daily_avg_plays = #{dailyAvgPlays}, last_play_at = #{lastPlayAt}
